product.name: 5mm Pitch HTD Timing Belt & Pulley Starter Pack (8mm REX® Bore)

warnings: No dimensions were scraped and the text gives none, so the bounds are a rough estimate. Sizing assumptions: the large hub-mount pulleys are about 75-80 mm OD (about 48 teeth at 5 mm pitch) and about 20 mm thick. The belts are about 15 mm wide, and the largest belt extends roughly 140 mm when laid out. The x/y bounds are a notional packed-kit footprint, and z is about the thickness of the largest pulley plus a little margin. The listed 8 mm REX bore and the 6 mm OD standoffs come from the description. Hole patterns in the large pulleys are visible but not dimensioned, so none are listed. The second image (four spacers/bushings) and the third (a goBILDA Yellow Jacket gear motor) do not belong to this kit and were ignored for sizing.
The kit is a multi-piece assortment, not a single part, so the model is a notional layout of simplified primitives.
No dimensions were provided, so all sizes are estimates taken from the image analysis.
The result is a compound of disjoint solids.
Belt teeth, pulley teeth and flanges, hex bores (modeled as round 8 mm), and the large-pulley hole patterns were omitted.
Sonic hubs, bearing idlers, small idlers, shims, screws and hex keys were omitted as too uncertain or too detailed.
The belts are modeled as simple stadium loops that are not to scale with the pulleys.
